public_naming: Use public display names only. SSH commands and personal aliases are returned by the access bot.

resources.name: Старый сервер (MIPT)
notes: Set CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID before PyTorch GPU selection.

resources.name: H200
access_steps: Send full name and MIPT email to @undef1ne5 to request VPN.
Wait for the VPN email from helpdesk02@vkusvill.ru.
Submit the access request through @brainlab_server_access_bot. No separate administrator message is required.

resources.name: 2 × A100 (BrainLab)
resources.network_requirement: MIPT network or MIPT VPN required before SSH access
resources.internet: No outbound internet on the server; copy packages and models with scp or rsync

resources.name: mlsub / Cloud.ru
notes: Existing approved access to the BrainLab server is required before requesting mlsub.
The mlsub request is approved separately by the administrator.
Use /home/jovyan for persistent cache and outputs.

resources.name: Alibaba
resources.network_requirement: Same VPN as H200 is required before connecting
access_steps: Reuse the H200 VPN if it is already configured.
Otherwise send full name and MIPT email to @undef1ne5 to request VPN.
Wait for the VPN email from helpdesk02@vkusvill.ru.
Submit a separate Alibaba request through @brainlab_server_access_bot if it has not been submitted yet.
notes: After admin approval, the bot creates the Unix account and sends the credentials.
The requested Unix username becomes the Alibaba login.
The user guide is stored in ~/README.txt.
